title: Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes: Per-Product Holding Limit and One Product per Reservation
content:
Two limits govern how many Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes products a customer holds and how they are used together.

## 1. Holding limit per product

A customer may hold at most the product's holding limit of certificates or passes of one product in issued or active status. The count is taken over the customer's current portfolio at the moment of handling: every companion certificate or pass of that same product whose status is issued or active. An issue that would exceed the limit is not made, and the entitlement stays with the issuing source.

- Certificates or passes of that product in used, expired or revoked status do not count toward the limit.
- Products of a different product name are counted separately.

## 2. One companion product per reservation

Only one companion product may be used on one reservation: a certificate and a pass, or two certificates, are never combined for the same trip where the product does not allow combination with another companion product, and one certificate covers at most the product's number of companions per reservation.

## 3. Choice among several eligible products

When the holder has several eligible products for the same trip, the one with the earliest book-by date is used unless the holder names another.

## 4. Fares that never take a companion product

Companion products are never combined with an award ticket for the holder, with a corporate agreement fare or with Crestline Basic Economy.

## Hypothetical cases

| Situation (hypothetical) | Outcome under these rules |
|---|---|
| The holder has an active Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus with book-by date 30 June and another with book-by date 15 September, both eligible for the trip, and names neither | The certificate with book-by date 30 June is used. |
| Same as above, but the holder names the September certificate | The September certificate is used. |
| The holder's own ticket is in Crestline Basic Economy | No companion product is used on that reservation. |
| An issue would bring the customer's issued or active certificates of one product above that product's holding limit | The issue is not made; the entitlement stays with the issuing source. |
